verdict.rationale: LiveKit's public pricing page offers a self-serve preview of the per-minute cost to run an agent on LiveKit Cloud, so some cost modeling is possible without sales. The evidence shows no actual published rates per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth. missing for 10: explicit per-participant-minute rates, bandwidth/egress unit pricing, stated rate figures beyond agent per-minute cost, independent corroboration that pricing is fully self-serve.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales

citations.quote: Preview the per-minute cost to run an agent on LiveKit Cloud.
